page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-90 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor offering 45 physical cores and 90 dedicated vCPUs with two threads per core. Hardware instruction support includes AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16, alongside hardware-accelerated cryptographic extensions such as AES and SHA-NI. System memory totals 360 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per vCPU. The instance contains no dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs, includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and provisions zero local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistence.

Benchmark evaluation reveals top-tier multi-core performance, placing the instance in the top 10% across stress-ng multi-core testing, PassMark CPU evaluation, and Clang software compilation. Cryptographic execution and ray tracing also achieve top-decile standings, aided by AVX-512 and dedicated hardware cipher support. Cached memory bandwidth delivers strong throughput exceeding 6,300 GB/sec, while uncached read bandwidth reaches 217.54 GB/sec. Conversely, single-core execution profiles are moderate, with Geekbench single-core scores falling within the middle 50% tier. Additionally, uncached large-block write bandwidth exhibits middle-tier performance at 77.61 GB/sec.

From a resource density and cost efficiency perspective, c3d-standard-90 provides high compute concentration per instance footprint, maximizing throughput for horizontally threaded and containerized systems. However, users must account for the absence of onboard NVMe storage, which introduces dependency on network-attached storage bandwidth and input/output latency. Given its strong Redis SET throughput of over 118 million operations per second and 54 GB/sec static web serving capacity, this instance fits high-concurrency database caching, continuous integration build clusters, parallel data transformation, and large-scale web application backends.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-90 is a general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 45 physical cores, 90 dedicated vCPUs, and 360 GB of system memory, matching a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The configuration includes advanced instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, but excludes integrated GPUs and local disk storage. In benchmark evaluations, the platform demonstrates top-tier multi-core computing capability, excelling in parallel code compilation, encryption tests, and ray tracing benchmarks. Read memory bandwidth and Redis throughput remain strong, while single-core performance and uncached write speeds register in average percentiles. Without bundled local disks, storage must be attached over the network. The hardware profile offers high multi-threaded compute density, making it suited for continuous integration build farms, container orchestration, caching layers, and high-throughput web serving environments.
